title: Sorta Works, but unpractical and dangerous.  Investigate better options.
text: Sorta Works, but unpractical and dangerous.  Investigate better options.. Beef has to be thicker, like a 1+" slab for this board to work.  If its already too thin, you won't be able to slice it as the meat will just duck under the knife.  Knife was like a butter knife, didn't seem sharp at all.  Seemed to be more of a finger hazard.  I thought of getting an electric carver knife, but realized that a trip to the ER Room just wasn't worth it and would set me back probably thousands of lost wages and doctor bills.  So I just  I bought a $500 deli meat slicer so I can make some Beef Jerky with consistent slice depth.

product_metadata.title: TSM Products Jerky Cutting Board and 10-Inch Slicer Knife
features: Unique jerky slicing tool for cutting thin strips of meat
Pre-Set to cut 1/4 inch slices of meat
Includes food grade plastic insert for adjusting Thickness of slices
description: Easily slice your favorite cut of meat for making jerky from strips of whole meat. The Stainless Steel cutting board is preset to cut approximately 1/4" thick slices for optimum drying. Comes with 2 food grade plastic inserts to adjust the thickness of the jerky slices. Both the cutting board and knife are dishwasher safe for easy clean up.
